verified_facts: INSPIRE Index Polygons are available under OGL
HMLR also lists National Polygon Service as a separate spatial-data product
not all HMLR datasets share the same licence/access terms
open INSPIRE must not be represented as National Polygon Service data
candidate geometry provenance must retain the source product class
paid/restricted data must not be inferred from open data
NPS lifecycle fields are usable only when actual NPS data is legitimately available
absence of NPS entitlement does not justify synthetic lifecycle values
quality_effect: Prevents open INSPIRE geometry from being silently promoted to restricted NPS semantics.
